AC VERIFICATION AGAINST THE MERGED TREE — all four verified. Merged 0c5b43cfa (Gerrit 1286, LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1). This comment also DISCHARGES AC3 "and recorded" ON THE TICKET, which is where the audit trail belongs — the decision previously lived only in the commit message, the docstring and a test.

THE ATTESTED ARCHITECTURAL GUARD HELD — checked FIRST, because this ticket was ORIGINALLY FILED proposing provider.startswith("gateway/"), which would have violated it:
  grep -c "startswith" src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py  =>  0   (zero, in code AND comments)
  Guard test test_capabilities_module_still_has_no_provider_name_prefix_matching (tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py:119) is an AST walk asserting no startswith/endswith Call node anywhere in capabilities.py. UNCHANGED by this commit and GREEN.
  The shipped fix is SET MEMBERSHIP, not prefix shape:
    capabilities.py:384  _GATEWAY_PROVIDER_NAMES = frozenset({...})  (5 exact ids)
    capabilities.py:434  via_gateway = provider in _GATEWAY_PROVIDER_NAMES
    capabilities.py:439  "tier": "best_effort" if (base_url or via_gateway) else "first_class"
  The prefix approach originally filed was NOT implemented. Registry membership, zero exceptions, holds.
  (startswith does appear in a TEST helper, test_verdict_provenance.py:220, to derive the expected set from config.KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES. The ban is scoped to capabilities.py and the test docstring says so.)

AC1 gateway/* stamps best_effort, RED before the fix — CONFIRMED BY EXECUTION, not inference: test_verdict_provenance.py:264 test_gateway_provider_without_base_url_is_best_effort, parametrized over all 5 gateway ids. Running the POST-fix test file against 0c5b43cfa~1 source (PYTHONPATH pinned to the pre-fix tree): 7 failed, 24 passed — the 5 tier params fail on AssertionError plus 2 ImportError on _GATEWAY_PROVIDER_NAMES. The "fails before the fix" clause is demonstrated, not assumed.

AC2 no collateral damage: :287 test_direct_providers_with_no_base_url_stay_first_class (anthropic, bedrock, openai, google-cloud, groq, vertexai) and :278 test_gateway_tier_is_not_decided_by_the_provider_names_shape — mygateway, openai-gateway, gateway, gateway-anthropic all stay first_class, which is the anti-prefix-matching rule asserted as BEHAVIOUR. Both pass post-fix AND passed PRE-fix in the RED run, so they are genuinely unchanged rather than newly satisfied.

AC3 endpoint_host — DECIDED: NOT back-filled. A gateway provider keeps endpoint_host = None unless a base_url was actually configured. Rationale: endpoint_host reports what was CONFIGURED, so synthesising a hostname from a provider id would report a value nobody set. Enforced executably at :297 test_gateway_endpoint_host_stays_none_unless_a_base_url_was_actually_configured — None for gateways, "gw.example.test" when a base_url IS set. Also in the commit message and the provenance_for docstring (capabilities.py:420-429). Recorded here to close the audit gap.

AC4 lint/typecheck/default selection: Verified +1 on the merged change ran exactly those; stated as inference. Independently the directly relevant modules run green: 124 passed across test_agentic_message_cache, test_verdict_provenance, test_bedrock_provider, test_llm_capabilities, test_pydantic_ai_runner and the execution-mode dispatch interface test.
